title.zh: 合作社（第 97 条下的豁免）（第 2 号）命令 2017

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Co-operative Societies (Exemption under Section 97) (No. 2) Order 2017 and comes into operation on 31 August 2017.

2. NorthLight School Multipurpose Co‑operative Limited is exempt from section 89(3) of the Act, insofar as —
(a)any moneys remaining after the application of its funds to the purposes specified in section 88 of the Act; and
(b)any sums unclaimed after 2 years from the date of cancellation of its registration,
are to be donated to the General Fund of NorthLight School, instead of being transferred to the Co‑operative Societies Liquidation Account.
